sources.title: [📚정보] 전투력 보정 정리
sources.summaryEn: Explains the stepped final-damage multiplier from team power vs. a stage's recommended power (sourced from crumblehub.co). Below 100% of the recommendation, damage drops in steps. At 120% or more it caps at 120%. This is for stages. The post doesn't say whether Guild Conquest uses it.

sources.title: [📚정보] 스킬가속 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of game version 1.1.002. Skill haste uses the LoL-style formula: final CD = base CD × 100/(100+haste). Only the root skill cooldown is hasted. Internal delays of multi-stage skills, such as child spawn delays and dash intervals, are not. That is why haste seems to work differently per cookie.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치명 관련 스탯 정리
sources.summaryEn: Datamine of the crit system. Crit rate above 100% gives tiered crits: 1st/2nd/3rd-degree crits, where the integer part is guaranteed and the fraction is the chance of the next tier. Crit multiplier = 1 + tier × (0.5 + bonus crit dmg). Past 100% effective crit rate, crit damage is worth more per point than crit rate. Sugar-rune max per line is 8% for both crit rate and crit damage.

sources.title: [📚정보] 띄우기 저항 작동 방식 정리
sources.summaryEn: Lift resistance shortens airborne time; it is not a chance to ignore the lift. Resistances combine multiplicatively, and a skill is cancelled if the cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Base 20% + Pinot Noir 35% = 48%, and adding the Panda Dumpling pet's 20% gives 64%, so a 1 s lift drops to 0.36 s and no longer cancels skills. The OP also gives lift durations for several cookies.

sources.title: 토벌전 30초 이후 쿠키가 사는 조건 생각해봄

Front-liners already low die to the jump; when bombs spread across Herb/Dark Choco/실론 everyone survives at ~half HP. ~1–2 in 5 runs all survive with mercenary lv3. Stat screens: Scorpion (never died) HP 3.88M, crit res 56.9%, DR 16.61%, skill amp 159.72%, crit 425.11%, crit dmg 161.77%, speed 3.5, haste 24; Ceylon Knight (dies most) HP 3.54M, crit res 56.9%, DR 18.52%, skill amp 38.62%, crit 142.25%, crit dmg 154.77%, speed 4.5, haste 27. When 실론 survives, runs hit near-best.

Pets 판다 16, 핫도그 19, yellow pet 20.

sources.title: [📚정보] 슈가룬 질문많길래 정리해봄
sources.summaryEn: Per-cookie sugar rune stat priorities by role. The key rule: dealers get no ATK% because Milk must be the highest-ATK cookie. Milk's buff scales with her ATK, and a mercenary-corps perk gives the top-ATK cookie a 20% ATK card. Bright Seeker takes skill amp and haste, or all haste for conquest high scores. Pomegranate is all skill amp and Milk is all ATK%.

sources.title: [📚정보] 치즈 우유 버프 정리
sources.summaryEn: Tested on a Lv.1 GingerBrave with Milk (Lv.100) and Cheesecake (Lv.91). Cheesecake's ATK buff has priority over Milk's: a cookie that gets Cheesecake's buff loses Milk's. Milk buffed by Cheesecake gives a much larger ATK buff, but only to cookies that did not also get Cheesecake's buff. So in conquest you want Cheesecake to buff Milk while the dealers dodge Cheesecake's buff, which the thread treats as a retry-lottery.

That line-up previously needed Cherry plus endless retries (the popular '치케 lottery manipulation' post). He scored 157G 391M at 627.68M power after 2 hours of retries. sources.title: 토벌 고점은 스가 인거 같다

sources.title: 마카롱 공증안줘도 되는 이유가
sources.titleEn: Why Macaron doesn't need ATK runes
sources.summaryEn: Milk's ATK buff scales with Milk's own ATK, not the target's. Scorpion ~300k ATK → 1.4M with Milk's buff → 3M if Milk has Cheesecake's buff too. So dealer levels matter little; skill amp is for damage, ATK amp only helps survival/straw targeting. Debate: ATK runes on Macaron are for guaranteeing Pomegranate's straw; alternative is lowering others' levels (e.g., to ~70 at Seeker 6★).

sources.title: 장비 선택 팁 준다
sources.summaryEn: General gear advice: stage at 55% cut — keep accuracy/focus ~80% of requirement, take higher power; 35% runs — accuracy/focus first; arena — haste + arena options; Crumble dungeon/raid — pick damage options.

sources.title: [📚정보] 장비 플레이트 강화 수치 / 옵션표
sources.titleEn: [Info] Gear plate enhancement values / option tables
sources.summaryEn: Full gear tables: main stat per slot, rarity multipliers, plate enhancement bonus (+0 to +20), sub-option count by rarity, and sub-option ranges per slot group. Skill haste appears only as a sub-option on accessories, at flat 1–2 per line before enhancement. Skill amp is a sub-option on weapons and attack accessories and the main stat of the Book (책).

sources.title: 토벌에서 렙낮추고 체리맛넣고 똥꼬쇼 하는 이유가 머임?
sources.titleEn: Why level down and use Cherry?
sources.summaryEn: Explanation: lowering levels sets ATK order for Pomegranate targeting; Cherry is inserted between Macaron and Seeker so they line up. After the Cheesecake lottery died, Macaron single-line works without Cherry; one commenter says Cherry was 'mostly a scam from the start'.

sources.title: 200g클럽
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple on the Global/English client: 199,092,348,546 (199.1G) at 685.14M (~291x), ended 17.233; 160G dealt by the 30 s mark. Perks 20/7. Pomegranate's 3-buff went to 우/피/브/전/마. Low levels on Dark Choco/Pinot/Herb are to steer Pomegranate; exact-level tuning also works but Milk stack differences sometimes break it. Suggests using an arena-style gear preset. Rune details in post 64844.

sources.title: 길토 비법소스 찾은듯?
sources.summaryEn: After the Cheesecake-buff fix, move speed raised his peak ~100G. Level adjustment + move speed runes produce the single-file line (Macaron getting buffs while dodging Cheesecake) without Cherry and without infinite retries. Author ~1.5 total move speed; too much breaks placement. Candy Apple: controlling via move speed beats infinite retries on bad placement; 1 gear line is always worth it. Patch detail: Cheesecake used to overwrite Milk's buff; now Milk's stacked buff no longer gets overwritten when higher, raising lottery odds.

sources.title: 이속 세팅 공유함
sources.summaryEn: Candy Apple's rune screenshots (English client) behind his 199G run: Pinot, Melon Soda and Bright Seeker runes, with move speed on each; 'don't give Seeker too much'. Gear: move speed + haste on 2 of the bottom-right three pieces (raid/crumble-dungeon preset used for all three modes). Status-screen move speeds: Cheesecake 5.5, Melon 6.51, Pinot 6.31, Seeker 5.38. Buffer runes matter most, placement second; dealers' extra skill-amp/crit-dmg % barely matter. Milk has only one SSR ATK line despite 'millions spent'.

sources.title: 슈가룬 추천기 화면 ㄱㅊ?
sources.summaryEn: A player built an Excel sugar-rune optimizer. On his data it recommends: Milk all ATK (8 lines ~56.6%), Pomegranate/Macaron/피겨/Cheesecake all skill amp (8 lines ~40%), 실론 1 ATK + 7 skill amp, dealers either all skill amp or all crit rate (~64%); estimated total damage 425.86M → 977.54M (+135%). Max per line: ATK 7%, crit rate 8%, crit dmg 8%, skill amp 5%. A commenter (칰킨) posts full buffer stats and runes.

sources.title: [📚정보] 슈가룬 요약(토벌전 기준)
sources.summaryEn: Sugar-rune optimizer output from the 65772 calculator for a 12-cookie conquest team where Pomegranate buffs 5 targets. It assumes Macaron, Milk (buffed by Cheesecake), Figure and Ceylon buffs always land. Milk goes all ATK%, Pomegranate all skill amp, and Cheesecake and Figure all skill amp. Macaron and Ceylon get just enough ATK% to enter Pomegranate's top-5, with the rest in skill amp. Dealers that receive Pomegranate's buff go all crit (crit dmg at 10 Macaron stacks, crit rate at 5 or 0 stacks); dealers that don't go all skill amp. The recommended runes roughly double the calculated damage.

sources.title: 나 토벌 이 점수면 찾을 수 있는 세계선 다 찾은거임?

sources.title: 호황 지리노

sources.title: [일반] 길드토벌전보스 클뜯 해봤는데

sources.title: 만년서버2등ㅂㅅㅅㄲ인 저의 아레나 덱에 조언부탁드립니다

Advice: Milky Way only belongs in a five-ranged deck; drop Herb and add Espresso; drop Milky Way for Oven, which draws Wind Archer's ultimate (nearest enemy) and Donut's polymorph (highest HP) if it has the most HP (claim); without merc level 4, Milky Way and Ion aren't worth it, Cheesecake and Crepe are better.

sources.title: [일반] 방체 연구 어느정도 해야 토벌전 30초버텨짐?

sources.summaryEn: OP already survives the 30 s slam but the team then dies to mob self-destructs. A commenter gives a concrete threshold: with a crit-res/DR gear preset, front row ~5M HP and back row ~mid-3M HP guarantees reaching 17 s.

sources.title: 나만 쓰는 아레나 덱

Rule: if you reach 17 s with a skill-amp setup, skill amp is the ceiling; if not, ATK amp is.

sources.title: [일반] 100배도 안뽑히는데 어케하노

sources.title: 공증단 250배
sources.summaryEn: Author settles on ATK-amp runes (250x) rather than swapping ATK/skill-amp for raid; notes skill-amp setup still scores higher. Nobody had survived 17 s at 9/17 even heavy spenders (max ~3G power).

sources.title: 토벌 정전vs허브는 체방 구간마다 다 다름

If you survive 30→17 without Herb, JW is again the ceiling, but JW's longer buff interval and range far from Pomegranate need more retries.
