sources.title: 크럼블 허브 유저 공유 덱: 아레나
sources.summaryEn: 80 shared decks in mode 'arena' (2026-08-04 to 2026-09-25); crumblehub has no rumble_arena mode (400 Invalid mode), so decks posted after 2026-09-23 may be for either PvP mode. Records hold 12 cookies, 3 pets, captain slot and mercenary-band perks, with up/down votes; no levels, stars, runes or gear. Appearance count across decks: 석류맛 쿠키 70, 바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유맛 쿠키 68, 이름 모를 케이크 들개 67, 마카롱맛 쿠키 61, 도넛행성 에일리언 도넛킹 51, 바람궁수 쿠키 50, 허브맛 쿠키 50, 밀키웨이맛 쿠키 46, 포도넝쿨맛 쿠키 42, 치즈케이크맛 쿠키 40, 피노누아맛 쿠키 31, 탐험가맛 쿠키 26, 호밀맛 쿠키 26, 이온맛 쿠키로봇 26, 피겨여왕맛 쿠키 22, 에스프레소맛 쿠키 20. Pets: 갓난갓방울 60, 핫도그도그 40, 사바나나 사자 15, 전지멜로우 15, 근엄한 초코왕방울 14, 와사비 문어 12. The August consensus core is 바람궁수 + 밀키웨이 + 석류 + 우유(소아과) + 도넛킹 + 들개 + 허브 + 마카롱 + 포도넝쿨 + 탐험가 + 치즈케이크 with a carry slot (호밀 / 에스프레소 / 악마). The decks posted from 2026-09-23 (4) switch to the Rumble-board cookies (바리공주, 체리콜라, 달토끼, 이온, 피노누아).

researchRecords.question: There is a small, documented set of Guild Conquest teams that KR/Global top players use to reach ≥1T damage. For each one, the community sources name the cookie lineup, levels (including deliberate Lv.1 fillers), sugar runes, gear stats, pets and perks precisely enough that someone with every cookie could reproduce it.
researchRecords.lede: What Korean and global players run in Guild Conquest (길드 토벌전), taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe and crumb.gg. Every claim links to the post it came from.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-27. Season 5 closed 2026-09-28 12:00 KST, and its final boards haven't been re-pulled yet, so the rankings here are from before the close. The Season 5 leaders (2.3–3.2T) haven't published their teams. The decks here are the best documented ones. The top documented run is 1T 999G with the Cherry deck (score screenshot posted by DC user awkward2637, who also posted 섬영's lobby; crumb.gg lists it as 섬영, 판도라); its team power isn't shown anywhere, and the author's own ~650× puts it near 3G. The research record's README.md lists what's still open.

researchRecords.question: For each PvP mode (regular Arena and Rumble Arena) there is a small documented set of top teams, and for each one the community sources name the lineup, formation, levels, stars, runes, gear, pets and the teams that beat it precisely enough that someone with every cookie could reproduce it and pick a counter.
researchRecords.lede: What Korean and global players run in PvP: regular Arena (아레나) and Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나), taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe, YouTube guides and crumb.gg. Every claim links to the post it came from.
researchRecords.caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-27, four days into Rumble Arena and Princess Bari. Stars are rarely readable in screenshots, no site publishes win rates for either mode, and regular Arena has no ladder data at all.

recordModes.lede: Regular, per-server Arena. Two decks lead as of 2026-09-27: the Rye one-carry deck and Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola, with the matchup decided by Bari's and Oven's stars.
recordModes.caveat: No stats site covers regular Arena, so rankings rest on forum posts and screenshots. Many screenshots posted as Arena are Rumble (server tags, +125/+175 medals); those are counted under Rumble.

recordModes.lede: Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나, 와레나): the cross-server arena added on 2026-09-23. The top 100 run one 12-cookie team built on the Oven–Bari charge core, carried by the Season 1 Charge buff.
recordModes.caveat: Four days of data. The game hides some defenders, so crumb.gg's usage counts are lower bounds, and crumb.gg shows no levels, stars, runes or gear.

decks.ceilingText: The tool of server #1s. At Bari 10★ the Rye deck 'can't hold at all'; a 1★-Bari version at 6.14M beat older decks at twice its power in launch week.
decks.summary: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance wraps the charge cookies (herself plus one ally, two from 5★) in damage reduction, lift and push immunity and periodic damage, and all three chargers dash at the highest-ATK enemy, usually Milk. The dive does about 2M per charger within 3.5 s at equal power. It lives or dies on Bari's and Oven's stars: strong from 5★, dominant at 8–10★, and beaten by the Rye deck below that when the dive doesn't kill.
decks.formation: Owner's formation screen, preset 'PVP 전용', 14.49M (nv:45718, the same screenshot as nv:45502). Levels are from dc:75598's defense card, which shows the same 12 at Lv.100 in mirror order (inferred: an opponent's card appears to put their front column on the left). Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.perks: Captain Milk. The defense in dc:75598 runs merc squad Lv.4 with 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이, and the Lv.4 captain was the difference the thread found. nv:45718 recommends 열정페이 + 초고속 승진 at Lv.4, and 초고속 승진 or all-cookie ATK/DEF/HP +2% at Lv.3.
decks.rng: At equal power the dive either kills in about 3.5 s or fails against shields and polymorph, after which the deck has no sustain. Which happens is a timing roll.
decks.atkOrderNote: Only Milk's rank is fixed (ATK #1 for Passion Pay). Pomegranate's beam then goes to the next-highest ATK, usually a charger.

decks.ceilingText: 17.59M defense beat a 17–18M Rye one-carry deck 3 times out of 3, despite the attacker's 1,100 accuracy (dc:75993).
decks.summary: Chain synergy from Skating Queen and the Fluffy Cheese Cat pet feeds several sub-dealers (Vampire, Pinot, Twizzly Gummy, Dr. Bones). Spread damage takes apart a one-carry team's supports, and an isolated Schwarzwälder soaks Rye's first volley.
decks.formation: Only the opponent's defense card (상대 방어팀) exists, which shows the grid mirrored, so no slots are given. Card order as displayed: Ion, Milk, Schwarzwälder, Vampire, Cheesecake, Macaron / Dr. Bones, Hound, Twizzly Gummy, Skating Queen, Pomegranate, Pinot. Pets ★20 each; the third pet is unidentified (commenters call it an evasion pet).

decks.summary: Talked about as the Rye deck's counter: Crepe knocks the enemy Moon Rabbit back before its debuff lands, and Espresso's black hole launches Rye out from the back line. No formation screenshot or result exists; the lineup is a commenter's guess.

decks.ceilingText: Reached Grand Master 2 and 9th overall in Arena Season 4 at 11.13M (dc:72977).
decks.summary: Arena presets carry almost no accuracy and typical evasion is about 650, so a team stacked to about 1000 evasion makes attackers miss. Vampire's bat hits the highest-ATK enemy and lowers its accuracy. It beats unprepared teams regardless of power and loses even to far weaker teams that attack with accuracy lines.
decks.formation: dc:72977, preset 아레나 회피, 11.13M, owner's formation screen. Pets: Mango Toucan ★20, Holy Baby Drop ★20, Chargemellow ★19. Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.rng: Every attack is a roll against evasion; the poster watches at 0.5× speed for MISS.

decks.summary: The Season 4 meta before Princess Bari: five ranged dealers for All Ammo Provided (+15 Skill Haste with 5+ ranged), winning by killing or polymorphing the enemy Milk first. Outclassed since 2026-09-23 by both the Rye one-carry and the Bari–Oven decks.
decks.formation: From a defense log (not the formation grid), so no slots. Pets: Chargemellow ★20, Holy Baby Drop ★20, King Choco Drop ★16.
decks.perks: 열정페이 + 탄약비 전액 지원 (All Ammo Provided).

decks.ceilingText: 13.27M (Rockstar version) beat a 20.4M server #2 running Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in regular Arena Season 5; Rye alone dealt 2.21M (dc:75148).
decks.summary: Rye is the only real damage dealer and everything else keeps her alive and buffed. Three tanks switch on Armor Repair, three healers plus Ion's shields outlast the Bari dive, and Pomegranate's first beam is routed onto Rye through ATK order. Since 2026-09-27 most of the top of at least one server has gone back to it; it loses to Bari–Oven only when Bari and Oven are very high-star.
decks.formation: Owner's formation screen (dc:74483), preset 아레나/토벌, 13.87M. That post's defense logs carry Rumble markers (server tags, +125 medal rewards, 익명의 도전자), so the lineup was shown for Rumble; it is probably identical in both modes, since the preset is shared. Pets on the screenshot: Holy Baby Drop ★20, Chargemellow ★17, Hot Doggie ★20. Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.perks: Captain Milk at merc squad Lv.4: 방어구 수리 특약 (Armor Repair, +10% DR with 3+ tanks) + 열정페이 (Passion Pay). In the mirror match the side with perks set wins. Alternatives: Armor Repair + 의료보험 (Health Insurance); 크런치 모드 (Crunch Mode) aimed at a Rye whose armour is removed so she is the lowest-HP ally.
decks.rng: Against Bari–Oven the fight is decided in the first few seconds: if Ion's and Rockstar's shields and Doughnut's polymorph land before the three chargers connect, Rye wins the long fight; if not, the team is deleted in about 3.5 s. 'Whoever loses Milk or Bari first loses.'
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate, so Pomegranate's beam lands on Rye. Count pet, perk and captain ATK% when checking, and check in battle. Supports can be levelled down to hold the order.

decks.nameEn: Rye deck, Brightseeker + Doughnut King version
decks.ceilingText: Rye 2.26M damage in one win (dc:74746); loses to the Grapevine version at about 2M more power (dc:76602).
decks.summary: The Rye one-carry deck with Brightseeker and Doughnut King in the Grapevine and Skating Queen slots. Only worth it with a 5★+ Brightseeker, and still judged weaker: Brightseeker's drones vanish when their target dies and she hits one target, while the deck loses its second healer.
decks.formation: dc:76349, 16.56M, owner's formation screen. Pets ★20 each. Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.perks: Not stated in the posts; the Rye decks run 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이.
decks.atkOrderNote: dc:74746's poster gives Rye just enough ATK to sit behind Milk and Brightseeker.

decks.summary: Everyone except the buffers is levelled down to Cheesecake's ATK so Cheesecake herself receives Pomegranate's beam and passes a bigger ATK buff to Milk. Documented by the author of the skill-haste study.

The standard high-end deck since 9/20. Five cookies sit at Lv.1 so Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams land only on the carries, and Cherry pulls the team into a straight line so Macaron's crit-rate buff reaches Brightseeker.
decks.formation: No move speed on any rune or gear piece. Cherry does the aligning; any move speed breaks it.
decks.perks: Leader Milk. 복지 (welfare): 열정페이 + 초고속승진, both landing on Milk. Mercenary squad Lv.4 for the second welfare slot and the third pet slot.
decks.rng: At 1.74G power, 1T lands in 1–2 of 10 runs and 1.1T occasionally. At 0.97G the author reports a 150× floor, a 250–350× average and a 400×+ peak. Ten minutes of hand play gives about 300–350×; the 400× record took 14 hours of overnight macro retries.
decks.atkOrderNote: Order by 공격력 (ATK), not 전투력 (power). Pomegranate is outside the order. If Macaron still has ATK runes it becomes Milk › Brightseeker › Macaron › Skating Queen › Tea Knight › Cheesecake.

decks.summary: The survival fallback for accounts whose team dies at the 30 s slam. Herb replaces Tiger Lily, so Pomegranate fires 5 beams and only ATK ranks 1–5 matter.
decks.perks: 열정페이 fixed, plus 초고속승진 (or a survival perk if the team is still dying).
decks.rng: Raises the floor more than the ceiling. One poster went from about 93× to 228× at 540M by fixing perks, with no deck change.

decks.summary: Week-2 ceiling deck. It needs a run where Cheesecake's ATK buff hits only Milk and Scorpion. Superseded by the level-down and Cherry decks.
decks.rng: The author played 4,230 runs in one season and still finished around 87×.

decks.summary: Replaces Cherry with Melon Soda and aligns the team through move speed on sugar runes. Higher peak per power than Cherry when the line forms, but the tuning is per-account and unforgiving.
decks.formation: Move speed only from sugar runes, on Brightseeker, Pinot and Melon Soda. None on gear. The target is a single line (일렬).
decks.rng: The source player gets a good alignment in about 3 of 4 runs. A 0.03 speed difference can stop the line forming at all. The same setup aligned on one device and not on another (Galaxy vs Lenovo tablet).
decks.atkOrderNote: Scorpion sits exactly 7th, ahead of Melon Soda and Dark Choco.

decks.ceilingText: Its player (설화) was #4 at 2,521 points on 2026-09-23; Bari dealt 2.78M (dc:73857).
decks.summary: Bari and Cherry Cola dive while Crepe pushes the enemy front line together for them. It crushed Bari + Oven decks, including the then-#1, while 2M lower, but lost to every deck with Rye, even when 2M higher.
decks.formation: Only a battle-stats screen: four of the twelve cookies aren't visible and no grid is shown.

decks.ceilingText: 18.67M beat 15.35M with Bari 1.58M and Oven 1.21M damage; +19 points at about 1,800 (web:yt-_D4EvaRYdJY).
decks.summary: The charge core for a Bari under 5★: Bari covers only one charger, so it runs Oven Wanderer as her single soul target and fills the other charger slot with Brightseeker and Rye. Every rune line is on screen, which makes it the best-documented build of the core.
decks.formation: Seo Sinwoo's formation screen, 18.68M. Pets: Holy Baby Drop ★20, Hot Doggie ★19, Icy Birdie ★20. Stars marked ~ are inferred from unlocked rune slots, not read from star icons. Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.perks: Captain Milk: 방어구 수리 특약 (3 tanks: +10% DR) + 열정페이. Pinned comment: if Bari keeps dying, 크런치 모드 instead of 열정페이.

decks.ceilingText: 8.41M with 1,005 evasion beat a 16.53M opponent with 950 accuracy, then won all 5 revenge fights (dc:74627).
decks.summary: An evasion gear set plus Vampire's accuracy-down makes attackers miss. Commenters dispute whether 1,005 evasion against 950 accuracy should matter and credit Vampire instead. Cross-server opponents can't scout it, which is why one player also runs evasion on the charge deck.
decks.formation: Attack preset 3. Slot row2-4 holds a water-element cookie with green hair that couldn't be identified (possibly Melon Soda), so it is left out. Two of the three pets are unreadable (★18 and ★20).

decks.nameEn: Ranged carry deck (Rye / Espresso / Brightseeker / Wind Archer)
decks.ceilingText: About 1,900 points is the ceiling at 12M after 260 fights; occasional wins against 20M (dc:73955).
decks.summary: The pre-Bari ranged meta brought into Rumble: Rye and Espresso (or Brightseeker, Wind Archer and Milky Way in other versions) behind Crepe and Ion. Charge decks delete it on contact even when it has 3–4M more power, and Espresso standing in the front line is exposed to Moon Rabbit.
decks.formation: dc:73955's attack-team card, 12.12M. Pets: Holy Baby Drop ★20, an unreadable ★17, Hot Doggie ★20 (icons read by the extraction). dc:75153's version: Crepe, Espresso, Rye, Wind Archer (바궁), Milky Way, Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Pinot, Doughnut King, Hound, Ion.
decks.perks: Not shown. dc:75153's version runs the 5-Ranged perk (탄약비 전액 지원).

decks.ceilingText: 18.77M beat a 27M Oven/Bari/Brightseeker team, with Rye 2.29M and Hound 1.30M damage (dc:74721). A commenter climbed from 14th to 5th with VART's version.
decks.summary: The mid-spec counter to the charge core. Rumble's +30% DR lets its Hound/Ion/Moon Rabbit front and two healers survive the opening dive, and then Rye out-damages. The same deck gets deleted in 0.5 s in regular Arena. At whale top-end the buffed divers win, and Rye is on only 6 of the top 100 defenses.
decks.formation: 러너's formation screen, preset 아레나/토벌, 18.77M. Pets: Holy Baby Drop ★20, Icy Birdie ★20, King Choco Drop ★16. Slots follow meta.json formation_slots.
decks.perks: Not shown. VART's version: captain Milk, 열정페이 + 방어구 수리 특약.
decks.rng: Wins depend on the tanks surviving the first dive; against max-spec Bari the divers kill on contact.
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate; Hound must also out-ATK any Milky Way so Macaron's buff routes to Rye (dc:75189).

decks.nameEn: Standard 12 (Oven–Bari charge core + support core + tank line)
decks.ceilingText: crumb.gg #1 凱凱の餅乾軍團 (rating 4095 at 2026-09-27 14:33Z) runs all twelve with these slots.
decks.summary: The one team of the Rumble Arena top 100: the Season 1 Charge buff (+30% max HP) lets Oven Wanderer, Bari and Cherry Cola survive their dive, Milk and Pomegranate buff them, and a Hound/Ion/Moon Rabbit front plus Herb holds the other side's dive. Boards that look like 8-cookie 'turtle' defenses are this team with hidden slots.
decks.formation: crumb.gg's 12-slot grid mapped onto formation_slots (slot i → row i%2+1, column ⌊i/2⌋+1); nv:45718's own formation screen shows the same layout. Pets: the same three on 73 of the top 100.
decks.perks: Not visible on crumb.gg or the in-game defense card. The forum standard for this core is captain Milk with 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이; nv:45718's Bari deck uses 열정페이 + 초고속 승진.
decks.rng: The game hides some defenders, so an attacker often can't see Oven, Bari or Cherry Cola before the fight. Displayed power predicts little: the top-20 member with the most power sits at #13.
decks.atkOrderNote: Milk ATK #1. Routing Pomegranate's beam onto Bari instead of Cherry Cola means stripping Cherry Cola's ATK; at 5★ posters give up on it.

decks.ceilingText: 12.28M beat 17.01M, 18.6M, 19.17M, 20.03M and 21.35M ranged teams in the screenshots, over about 100 fights (dc:74028).
decks.summary: SR-grade Wizard as the carry with Chargemellow's Rapid Fire synergy. Wizard out-damages every enemy carry once the fight passes about 10 s, and Rumble's +30% DR makes that survival likelier. Early-sweep Bari decks kill it in the opening (its author calls Bari 5★+ with Oven catastrophic), so he doesn't recommend it on defense.
decks.formation: Owner's formation screen on the 'arena' preset, 12.28M (dc:74028, and again in nv:45902). The first pet (★19) is unreadable in dc:74028; nv:45902 names it Chargemellow. nv:45902's title says Arena, but every fight it shows is Season 1 와글와글 아레나, in the same screenshots dc:74028 posted (player 내친구, S0005), so both are Rumble evidence.
decks.perks: 방어구 수리 특약 + 의료보험 (nv:45902): surviving the first turn is the whole plan. Not shown in dc:74028.

deckCookies.why: ATK #1 on purpose. The 열정페이 (+20% ATK) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) perks go to the highest-ATK ally, and Milk's own ATK buff scales with her ATK, so every point she gains is shared with the team. She's also always inside Pomegranate's beam set. Sugar runes are all ATK%, and 10★ matters.

deckCookies.levelRule: Lv.100, or as high as possible while ATK < Milk
deckCookies.why: The damage carry (one poster puts her above 90% of team damage) and a Light attacker against a Dark boss. She has to be ATK #2 so she's always in Pomegranate's beams. Stars matter a lot: posters measured +25–47% going 4★ → 5★ (5★ adds a drone), and one estimates about 1000× at 10★.

deckCookies.why: Skill-amp buffer with high base ATK, so she ranks into Pomegranate's beams without any ATK runes and every rune line goes to skill amp.
Hands out 300%+ crit rate, but only to cookies lined up with her. That's why Cherry is in the deck. ATK #4 (or #3 if you gave her ATK runes, which the guides now say to reroll to skill amp).

deckCookies.levelRule: Lv.100, or tuned to Lv.89–98 to sit just under Cheesecake
deckCookies.why: Her buff only works in Guild Conquest. She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, so her ATK rank flickers. Some top posters trim her level so she reliably sits 6th and a misfired beam still lands on a skill-amp user.

Her ATK buff lands on Milk, which raises Milk's buff for everyone, and her skill grants 다발 2, which takes Pomegranate from 3 beams to 5. When Pomegranate holds Tiger Lily's 다발 3 instead, she fires six, and Cheesecake is the sixth recipient. Levelling her down lets Pinot or Dark Choco, who get nothing from skill amp, steal that beam. Runes are all skill amp.

deckCookies.levelRule: Lv.1 or Lv.100: no damage difference
deckCookies.why: The buffer. Her +69% skill-amp beams don't scale with her level or ATK, and she never targets herself. Lv.1 only lowers team power, which inflates the damage ÷ power multiple (the #1 1T 312G run does this). She survives to the 17 s wipe either way. Runes are all skill amp.

deckCookies.levelRule: Lv.1–45, keeping ATK ≥10% below the 6th cookie after Octo Wasabi's +8%
deckCookies.why: A backstop, not a carry. When Tea Knight misses Milk's buff, a beam goes stray, and a few levels on Scorpion make it land on her (she uses skill amp) instead of Dark Choco (who doesn't). Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK when she enters, so check the order in battle, not in the lobby.

Kept Lv.1 so she never takes a beam. She's there for the 다발 3 her mount grants to nearby allies: Pomegranate holding it fires 6 beams instead of the 5 from Cheesecake's 다발 2. Pomegranate has to be near her when she mounts, so skill-haste runes let her mount before Pomegranate's second cast. If the team wipes at the 30 s slam, swap her for Herb (+2).

Brings a DEF-shred debuff. Skill amp doesn't boost that since the 8/27 patch, so her runes go to skill haste. Even at Lv.1 her ATK is high enough to steal a stray beam, which is why Scorpion is kept slightly higher.
Formation only. Her presence makes the team charge in a straight line, which puts Brightseeker (and Scorpion) inside Macaron's crit-rate buff. No investment needed.

Gives allies +35% lift resistance. The boss's launches cancel any skill if the cookie is airborne 0.4 s or longer, and Pinot plus a lift-resistance pet (64% total) keeps launches under that. Needs no ATK, so Lv.1.

deckNotes.text: Tiger Lily → Herb if the team dies at the 30 s slam. Herb gives 5 beams instead of 6, so Tea Knight drops to Lv.1 and only ranks 1–5 get buffed.
Cherry → Melon Soda if you're willing to tune move speed to 0.01 precision (see the Melon Soda deck).
Candy Shade Pouch replaced Panda Dumpling after 9/23 (more lift resistance plus 12.5% HP).
Five cookies at Lv.1, including the damage-dealer Scorpion in some versions and the buffer Pomegranate in the #1 run.
An R-rarity Cherry Cookie in an endgame team, purely for formation.
Scorpion levelled to a precise ATK window as a beam catcher rather than as a dealer.

Pet: Candy Shade Pouch, or Panda Dumpling. The deck's 1T run (about 1T at 1.6G, dc:74759) kept everything and swapped only to the new Candy Shade Pouch ('그대로 신규펫만'); its author found the pet's higher lift resistance shifted the alignment for the better at the old speeds. Others keep Panda because their speed values were tuned with it and the different lift resistance moves placement: 867G at 1.57G with Panda (dc:76144).
Lazy variant: Tiger Lily in Herb's slot with speed only on Pinot and Melon Soda. It aligns well but breaks the multi-hit chain, so damage is lower.
Move speed tuned to hundredths on sugar runes to script where each cookie stops.
A 5★ Brightseeker reached 637.8G at 1.14G power, higher per power than most 10★ Cherry decks at the time.
Back to Tiger Lily once the team survives to 17 s: its average is higher, and the ceiling is similar.
Grapevine → Rockstar (preferred since 2026-09-25): its shield comes out during Bari's first dive. Give it 3–4 Skill Haste lines.
Grapevine + Skating Queen → Brightseeker + Doughnut King only with a 5★+ Brightseeker; that version (arena-rye-seeker) loses to this one at 2M more power.
Grapevine → Espresso if Brightseeker is under 5★ and you have no Rockstar.
Chargemellow → Icy Birdie (DR) against burst-heavy servers, or → King Choco Drop.

Heal-tank variant (꿀빵): Moon Rabbit → Strawberry Crepe, with Ion and Crepe held in the high Lv.80s and Rye and Herb in the mid-90s to keep the ATK order Milk › Skating Queen › Macaron. Its author says his server's #1 and #2 run it.
Seo Sinwoo's low-rarity version: same 12, pets Holy Baby Drop / King Choco Drop / Icy Birdie, perks Crunch Mode + Armor Repair; 15.99M beat 16.8M and 16.65M Bari decks.
A single damage dealer in a 12-cookie team.
Skating Queen kept in a PvP deck (disputed).
SR Rockstar in the flex slot of a top team.
Rye's armour removed so Crunch Mode picks her as the lowest-HP ally (Seo Sinwoo variant).
Bari under 5★: keep one extra charger (Oven) and add Brightseeker (only at 5★+) or Herb; see rumble-bari-lowstar.
King Choco Drop → Icy Birdie (nv:45718's screenshot runs Holy Baby Drop ★20, Hot Doggie ★20, Icy Birdie ★19).
Cherry Cola → Strawberry Crepe: 14.2M beat 15.17M with Bari 2.09M and Oven 1.93M damage.
Cheesecake → Herb for steadier healing.
Oven → Skating Queen (올렐레오로리's final list).
Evasion version with Vampire and Peach, pets Mango Toucan + Eggbeak: 16.51M beat 21.43M; a Bari 10★ version posted Bari 1.60M and Cherry Cola 1.93M.
Three charge-type damage dealers in a meta built on ranged shooters.
A budget version works with Bari at 1★.
Ion → Strawberry Crepe (dc:76602's 13.33M version).

gearRecs.why: Move speed breaks the Cherry formation. The boss has low evasion and resistance, so accuracy and focus (stage stats) are dead lines.

gearRecs.why: Typical enemy evasion is about 650, so accuracy is dead weight outside evasion matchups; accuracy and focus are stage stats that inflate power (뻥투력).

Crit RES is useless in Guild Conquest and Skill Haste/crit RES lines show little power, so an arena preset looks weaker than it is. Every mode has its own preset slot. Noorimer (Season 3 #2) is the exception: one set for everything.

gearRecs.substats: Wear the arena preset, not the stage preset

gearRecs.why: The same Arena & Rumble guide applies the six-haste rule to both modes.

gearRecs.why: RES lowers the chance of receiving Moon Rabbit's debuff, which is on most Season 1 defenses; DR is worth more than crit RES against a crit-cutting Moon Rabbit.

mechanics.title: Pomegranate's beams (빨대)
mechanics.body: Her skill gives +69% skill amp for 9 s through beams. The beam count is 3 plus the Volley (다발) level she holds when she casts: 3 beams with none, 5 with 다발 2 (from Cheesecake or Herb), 6 with 다발 3 (from Tiger Lily). Levels don't add up; nobody reports more than 6. Volley is granted by ally skills, per the game's skill texts: Cheesecake's orbiting letters, Tiger Lily's mount (only to allies near her, so Pomegranate misses it when they stand apart) and Herb's heal. The top Cherry-deck player's retry checklist: Pomegranate on 다발 2 before 45 s left and on 다발 3 before 27 s left; a run that misses 다발 3 stays on 5 beams. Whether a later Cheesecake grant replaces a held 다발 3 is not in any source. Beams go to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power) and never to herself. Her level and ATK don't change the buff.

mechanics.title: Milk and the welfare perks
mechanics.body: Milk's ATK buff scales with her ATK. 열정페이 (+20% ATK, −20% max HP) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) go to the highest-ATK ally, so Milk has to be ATK #1. Milk usually dies at the 17 s wipe because of 열정페이's HP cut.

mechanics.title: Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's
mechanics.body: A cookie holding Cheesecake's ATK buff loses Milk's: measured 483K ATK with Milk alone vs 228K with both. The best case is Cheesecake buffing Milk (667K), which is why formation matters.

mechanics.title: Crit above 100%
mechanics.body: Crit rate past 100% rolls extra crit tiers: 200% always crits twice, and 198% is one crit plus a 98% chance of a second. Each tier adds (50% + bonus crit dmg). Above 100% effective crit rate, +10% crit dmg beats +10% crit rate. The raid boss has no crit resistance.

mechanics.title: Skill haste formula
mechanics.body: Cooldown = base × 100 / (100 + haste). 50 haste cuts a cooldown by 33%, not 50%. Only the parent skill's cooldown is hasted; internal delays and durations aren't. No cap was found in the data.

mechanics.title: Brightseeker haste breakpoint
mechanics.body: A model of a 43 s fight finds haste pays off steeply until about 40 total, then stalls. In a 30 s fight (team dies at the slam), trading haste for skill amp is better: going from 20 to 40 haste loses about 3.4%. Past about 58 haste her drones start splitting onto adds.

mechanics.title: Lift resistance
mechanics.body: A skill is cancelled if its cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Resistance stacks as base + extra − base×extra: 20% base, 48% with Pinot, 64% with Pinot plus a 20% pet. Candy Shade Pouch goes up to 30% (plus 12.5% HP).

mechanics.title: Skill amp nerf (8/27)
mechanics.body: Skill amp no longer boosts stat-reduction debuffs (Dark Choco included) or damage-reduction buffs, and enemy DEF can't go below 0. That's why Dark Choco runs haste.

mechanics.title: Boss
mechanics.body: 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타 (Extra Stuffed Piñata) is Dark with a Light weakness (Brightseeker is Light). Big slam at 30 s elapsed; super-jump wipe at 17 s remaining. Crit resistance on your side does nothing here, and accuracy and focus aren't needed.

mechanics.title: Octo Wasabi pet
mechanics.body: +40% duration-synergy effect and +10% ATK for duration-synergy allies. The pet card says 10%; posters and one video guide measure +8% when Scorpion enters (disputed). The bonus isn't shown on the stat screen, so ATK-order tuning has to add it by hand, and it can reshuffle the order mid-fight.

mechanics.title: Tea Knight is raid-only
mechanics.body: Every 10 s: a 155.2% ATK thunder strike and all allies Boss DMG +70% for 10 s, in Guild Conquest only (+45% at the lowest grade). That's why she's in every top deck. She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, which is the most common cause of stray beams.

mechanics.title: Surviving the 17 s wipe
mechanics.body: Posters put the floor at about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per surviving cookie. A 9.4M HP / 45.6% DR Brightseeker lived to about 9 s left using HP and DR pets. The ATK-order carries (about 5M HP) and Milk (열정페이 HP cut) still die; at 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen survived and kept dealing damage until 8 s left. This is the leading explanation for the Season 5 jump, but only as a timing match.

mechanics.title: No manual control since 9/10
mechanics.body: Manual control in Guild Conquest was removed on 9/10, so placement comes from deck composition only. That's why a Lv.1 Cherry Cookie is carried: it pushes Brightseeker in front of Macaron.

mechanics.title: Skill amp scales Milk's buff (8/13)
mechanics.body: Since the 8/13 patch skill amp applies to Milk's ATK-increase effect, which is why Milk is ATK #1 and the leader in every top deck.

mechanics.title: Weapon: crit rate or crit dmg
mechanics.body: At equal skill amp, check crit rate after Macaron's buff: under 30 (the last two digits) take crit dmg, at 30 or more take crit rate to push the next crit tier. Skill amp wins over both when it's higher.

mechanics.title: HP to survive the slam
mechanics.body: Cookies need about 3.5–4M HP to live through the 30 s slam. Level barely matters for that, because gear and lab HP research give a Lv.1 cookie about 4M HP in raid.

mechanics.title: Sugar rune slots and rolls
mechanics.body: Rune slots unlock with stars (★6, two at ★8, two at ★10). Per-line maxima: ATK% 7, crit rate 8, crit dmg 8, skill amp 5 (SSR), skill haste +5 (SSR; SR tops out at +3).

mechanics.title: Gear enhancement
mechanics.body: Sub-options jump at +5, +10, +15 and +20 (+130% at +15, +200% at +20). Max skill-haste roll is +4.6 at +15. Only accessory groups roll haste.

mechanics.title: Piñata's element
mechanics.body: Dark: the boss's lobby screen shows the moon icon.

mechanics.title: Piñata's weakness
mechanics.body: Light: the boss's lobby screen marks the sun icon as its weakness (약점).

mechanics.title: How a Piñata run is scored
mechanics.body: The score is the damage dealt before the 60 s timer ends the fight. A team that wipes early keeps the damage it already dealt: in one report a full wipe at the 30 s slam still scored over 100배.

mechanics.title: Buffs scale with the caster's skill amp
mechanics.body: Sugar Pocket's calculator computes a buff as floor(base × value × (1 + skill amp ÷ 100)), with the caster's skill amp, not the receiver's. When a buff's value is a share of the caster's ATK or HP, that stat is the base, so the caster's ATK or HP scales the buff too. This is a third-party calculator's code, not the game client's.

mechanics.title: Debuff application chance
mechanics.body: Sugar Pocket's calculator computes a debuff's chance to land as base chance × (the caster's focus ÷ the target's resist + focus% − resist%), clamped to 0–100%. Against a target with no resist the ratio counts as 1. Skill amp isn't in it. This is a third-party calculator's code, not the game client's.

mechanics.title: Piñata's English name
mechanics.body: 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타 is the Extra-Stuffed Piñata in the official English notes for the 8/27 update and in crumb.gg's patch digest. One English guide calls it the Overly Heavy Pinata. The name hasn't been read from the English client's game data.

mechanics.title: Why fillers sit at Lv.1
mechanics.body: Pomegranate's beams go to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power), so a cookie that shouldn't take a beam is kept at a low level, under the beam recipients in ATK. Scorpion is the tuned exception: levelled to sit exactly 7th in ATK, so a stray beam lands on her rather than on a filler.

mechanics.title: Format
mechanics.body: Asynchronous auto-battle: your attack team fights another player's saved defense team. Attack and defense teams are set separately. No bans, picks or rounds. You pick the opponent from a list; refreshing it can cost crystals. Continuous challenge (auto-repeat) since 2026-09-10.

mechanics.title: Team size
mechanics.body: 12 cookies and 3 pets per side, plus a captain and mercenary perks.

mechanics.title: Battle length
mechanics.body: About 60 s (the client stage table sets a 60,000 ms limit, last wave annihilated). Near the end the game announces '종료 임박 피해량이 더 증가합니다!' and damage increases. Speeds x0.5–x2 and skip.

mechanics.title: Matchmaking and visibility
mechanics.body: Per server; rankings are per server. Opponents' names and power are visible before you attack, but their gear isn't.

mechanics.title: Seasons and tiers
mechanics.body: Seasons of about two weeks, closing at 12:00 KST; Season 5 is live on 2026-09-27. From Season 3 (patch 2026-08-27) ranks 1–3 get Champion 1/2/3, and Master 4 to Grand Master 1 promote by absolute rank; Champion 1 needs 3,200 points and overall 1st. Promotion examples: Elite Master 1 needs 3,000 trophies and top 30; Grand Master 2 needs 3,000 and top 5.

mechanics.title: Points
mechanics.body: A defense loss to a lower player costs up to −5; the attacker gains +15 to +25. Revenge attacks from the defense log recoup more than the loss. Guide 43444 puts a failed defense at 1–3 points.

mechanics.title: Rewards
mechanics.body: Wins only (not losses) give Fame points, which level Boss, Element and Crit DMG (+74–76% at Fame Lv.112), plus Victory Medals. First promotions pay diamonds: Elite Master 1 and Grand Master 3 4,000, Grand Master 2 6,000. Season-end rewards by rank: Season 3 2nd received 50,000 crystals and 5,000 medals.

mechanics.title: Stats that apply
mechanics.body: Level, stars, collection, gear, plate enhancement, sugar runes, pet ownership effects, captain and mercenary perks apply. Breakthrough, Stellar Link, Gnome Lab and Guild Lab don't, so displayed power overstates PvP strength. The PvE final-damage power bracket is fixed at 100% in PvP. Guide 43444 lists perks as not applying; player tests say they do.

mechanics.title: Season buffs
mechanics.body: Regular Arena has no season passive. In Season 1 the defense team's DMG reduction wasn't applied (fixed from Season 2).

mechanics.title: Format
mechanics.body: The same auto-battle as Arena, alongside it rather than replacing it, but in one cross-server pool with no server-age brackets. Attack and defense teams are set separately, with 5 presets. No draft, bans or picks.

mechanics.title: Team size
mechanics.body: Up to 12 cookies (two rows of 6) and 3 pets. Empty slots are allowed; some players leave a 1-cookie defense to drop points on purpose.

mechanics.title: Battle length
mechanics.body: About 60 s with a visible countdown; speeds x0.5–x2, auto-repeat and skip.

mechanics.title: Seasons
mechanics.body: Irregular seasons, each with its own Rumble-only passive. Season 1 runs 2026-09-23 03:00 UTC to 2026-10-08 (battles close 03:00 UTC, 12:00 KST); the end date comes from the in-game timer and crumb.gg, not from official text.

mechanics.title: Season buffs
mechanics.body: Season 1: Charge (돌격형) cookies get +30% max HP, and all cookies and summons get +30% DMG reduction. Shown in the official announcement GIF, the in-game 와글와글 버프 panel and the EN client ('Rumble Buff').

mechanics.title: Tickets
mechanics.body: Its own ticket. The free cap is 5, refilled daily, and unused refills don't bank; the UI showed 8 at launch (an acknowledged display bug). Extra tickets cost 1,000 mileage each with no limit.

mechanics.title: Points and hiding
mechanics.body: The win value shows before the fight (+6, +10 and +19 seen); a loss at the top cost −5. A successful defense gives +1 or +2 points and 125 Rumble medals; a failed one costs −1 to −4. At 2,000+ points the opponent's name, power and levels show as ??? (익명의 도전자) while lineup and pets stay visible. Revenge attacks are available from the defense log.

mechanics.title: Leagues
mechanics.body: Platinum, Diamond, Master 5 to Master 1, then Champion 1 (the top grade). Promotion needs points and a percentile: Master 5 needs 2,000 points and top 80% and pays 1,500 gems. The EN client shows 'Crystal' tier names.

mechanics.title: Rewards
mechanics.body: Season ranking (gems + Rumble medals): 1st 60,000 + 25,000, 2nd 50,000, 3rd 45,000 (3,200 points for the top 3); top 10 40,000, top 30 35,000, top 100 30,000 (3,000 points); Master top 5/10/20/30% 25,000/24,000/23,000/22,000 gems with 20,000 or 15,000 medals (2,000 points). Daily ranking mails 2,500 medals to the top 100 and 2,000 to Master top 5–30%. Medals buy daily-dungeon keys, chocolate bars, syrup, Stella rune rewards and a random box in the Rumble shop.

mechanics.title: Stats that apply
mechanics.body: Per players, cookie stars and gear count, while breakthrough, research lab and Stella don't, and there are no guild effects. No official statement was found; perks likely apply as in Arena.

mechanics.title: Ruling: 'Rye beats Bari' in regular Arena
mechanics.body: The Rye one-carry deck beats Bari–Oven at similar power only while Bari is at 8★ or less; at 8–10★ Bari and Oven, or with a clear spec lead, Bari–Oven wins. Many of the gallery's 'Rye beats Bari' screenshots are Rumble fights (server tags, +125/+175 medals, anonymous challengers), where the +30% DR buff lets Rye's tanks survive the dive; the same Rye deck that holds up to +6M in Rumble dies in 0.5 s to the same archetype in regular Arena. The regular-Arena evidence for the edge is thinner: one Season 5 win at 13.27M over a 20.4M server #2, a server that wiped its 5★ Bari decks with Rye, and a server #1 with an 8★ Bari who switched to Rye.

mechanics.title: Ruling: Bari's star threshold against the Rye heal-tank decks
mechanics.body: 5★ is a floor, not a win condition. Below 5★ Soul Guidance covers one charger and Bari decks lose to Rye heal-tank decks and to Crepe decks. From 5★ it covers two chargers (Oven and Cherry Cola), and posters call Bari the performance pick in regular Arena, yet same-power Rye decks still shred 5★ and 8★ Bari decks, and a 7★ Bari with an 8–9★ Oven is 'meh' at the top. At equal spec a Rye deck with an 8★ Rye beats a half-built 5★ Bari deck. At 8★+ Bari punches through Moon Rabbit, and at 10★ posters say the Rye deck can't hold at all. The deciding factors named alongside stars are gear and a merc Lv.4 captain.

mechanics.title: Chargers dive the highest-ATK enemy
mechanics.body: Oven Wanderer, Cherry Cola and Princess Bari dash at the highest-ATK enemy, as does Vampire's bat. That is almost always the enemy Milk, whose ATK is inflated and whose max HP is cut 20% by Passion Pay. Whoever loses their Milk or their Bari first loses the fight.

mechanics.title: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance
mechanics.body: Bari wraps herself and one random charge-type ally (two from 5★) in DMG reduction, lift and push immunity and periodic area damage. The EN skill panel at 8★ shows a 5.5 s cooldown, 32% DR and guiding damage of 127.8% of the guided cookie's ATK, which fits the leak that the aura damage scales on the wrapped cookie's ATK; a rough datamine puts DR at 40% at 9★. Push and lift immunity is why Crepe and Espresso displacement fails against chargers.

mechanics.title: Moon Rabbit's debuff
mechanics.body: Moon Rabbit lowers ATK and crit rate of enemies near her (about −50% ATK and −130% crit at 9★ per a rough datamine, radius about 4.2), so mostly the enemy front line and often their Milk, which shrinks Milk's team buff. Knocking her back before she transforms avoids the debuff. Players disagree whether she is mandatory insurance against Oven or wasted outside Bari decks.

mechanics.title: The first cast wins
mechanics.body: Whoever casts first nearly always wins, so Skill Haste decides fights: a CC landing on a cookie as its cooldown ends delays the cast, and a skill interrupted by CC still counts as cast. Against the Bari dive, the opening is survived by Ion's and Rockstar's shields after their Skill Ready buff, Doughnut's polymorph and Herb healing Milk. Rockstar's cycle is about 5 s including Skill Ready against Grapevine's 5.5 s.

mechanics.title: ATK order routes the buffs
mechanics.body: Pomegranate's Skill AMP beam (빨대) and Macaron's crit buff pick allies by ATK rank. Players steer them with ATK% runes and by levelling supports down: Milk first (for Passion Pay), then the carry. Milk's rank counts pet, perk and captain ATK% too. Skill AMP scales every buff and debuff, not only damage.

mechanics.title: Formation geometry
mechanics.body: The formation screen shows two rows of six. Left to right runs back line to front line: Macaron (range 7) and Oven sit in column 1 and Herb (range 1.25) and Moon Rabbit (range 1) in column 6, and the Herb at the top-right is the one that 'dies first'. An opponent's defense card appears to show the grid mirrored. Hound's Range synergy lines up Macaron's march; Milky Way breaks it.

mechanics.title: Decoys and targeting
mechanics.body: Rye's first volley fires where she faces; an isolated Schwarzwälder absorbed it and the Rye deck lost 3 of 3. A claim that Doughnut's polymorph targets the highest-HP enemy and Wind Archer's ultimate the nearest, so a tanky Oven soaks both, is unconfirmed.

mechanics.title: Evasion against accuracy
mechanics.body: Typical Arena evasion is about 650 and arena presets carry no accuracy, so a team built to about 1000 evasion makes attackers miss regardless of power. Switching to a stage preset with accuracy beats it. Opponent gear isn't visible before a fight, but names are, so evasion defenders get remembered.

mechanics.title: Merc Lv.4 perks decide mirrors
mechanics.body: A merc squad Lv.4 captain unlocks the second perk slot: Armor Repair (+10% DR with 3+ tanks) with Passion Pay. In the Rye mirror the side without perks set loses, and a Lv.3 squad is at a real disadvantage. Armor Repair needs three tank-type cookies (Hound, Ion and Moon Rabbit are all tanks); whether it counts them in-game is assumed, not verified.

mechanics.title: Healing reduction ended the heal meta
mechanics.body: Since Pinot Noir (8/27), her healing reduction beats heal-heavy decks even at a power deficit, and two healers suffice. Milk can't heal herself, so Herb stays; Ion's and Rockstar's shields aren't cut by it.

mechanics.title: Displayed power overstates PvP strength
mechanics.body: Power counts breakthrough, Stellar Link and lab research that PvP ignores, and arena presets show lower power because Skill Haste and crit RES add little to it (뻥투력). Power gaps of 2× are beaten routinely by matchup and gear.

mechanics.title: Ruling: one 12-cookie team, not 'turtle vs charge'
mechanics.body: The Rumble top 100 run one team. The DC lane read the board as 8–9-cookie support 'turtle' defenses plus a separate Oven + Bari charge deck, but the game hides some defenders (264 of 1,200 slots on 2026-09-27 14:33Z). Every fully revealed team carries Macaron, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion and Moon Rabbit, almost all of them also Oven and Bari; where Oven and Bari both show, at least four support-core cookies show too; and the #1's revealed count went from 8 to 12 within five hours. The turtle and the charge deck are partial views of the standard 12. The open caveat: empty slots are legal (a day-1 #3 fielded 9 cookies and 3 empty slots), so a few real 8–9-cookie defenses can't be ruled out.

mechanics.title: Ruling: where 'Rye beats Bari' holds
mechanics.body: In Rumble the Rye anti-charge deck beats Bari charge decks at mid-to-upper spec and similar power, because the +30% DR lets its tanks and healers survive the dive. At whale top-end (SR cookies at 10★) the buffed divers kill on contact, and no top-10 player runs a Rye defense: Rye is on 6 of the top 100, all ranked 30–100. One poster measured about 4 wins in 10 against 5★ Bari decks. Most gallery screenshots of Rye beating Bari are from this mode, not regular Arena.

mechanics.title: What the Season 1 buff does to matchups
mechanics.body: +30% max HP on Charge cookies is why Oven Wanderer went from unused to meta and why Bari decks work at 2–3★ here. +30% DR for all cookies and summons blunts burst: pure dive decks (Cool Mint + Cherry Cola + Oven + Bari) failed under it, the same Rye deck survives Bari–Oven here and dies in regular Arena, and Wizard decks that survive 10 s win. Commenters expect Oven and Bari to fall off when the buff rotates.

mechanics.title: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance
mechanics.body: Bari wraps herself and one random charge-type ally (two from 5★) in DR, lift and push immunity and area damage scaled on the wrapped cookie's ATK (127.8% at 8★ in the EN skill panel). In Rumble the Charge HP buff stacks with it, which is why a 1★ Bari still tops damage charts (1.58M).

mechanics.title: Bari's stars in Rumble
mechanics.body: Bari decks win here at 2★ and 3★ (Bari dealing 2.03M at 2★). The common advice is Oven 7★ and Bari 5★, from which Soul Guidance covers both Oven and Cherry Cola; the #3 player ran Bari 6★ with Moon Rabbit 7★. Below 5★, run one extra charger. A guide notes that a sub-5★ Bari is more viable in Rumble than in regular Arena because of the Charge HP buff.

mechanics.title: ATK order routes the buffs
mechanics.body: Pomegranate's beam and Macaron's crit buff go by ATK rank. Rye decks set Milk › Rye ≥ Pomegranate with ATK% on Rye and Macaron; one player holds Pinot at Lv.99 so the beam goes to Macaron. To route the beam onto Bari instead of Cherry Cola you strip Cherry Cola's ATK; at 5★ posters give up on it.

mechanics.title: Moon Rabbit and Ion hold the dive
mechanics.body: Moon Rabbit's ATK-down on the enemy Milk collapses their buff chain, and with Ion in front forms the wall charge decks couldn't break even at +2M. Divers such as Ion or Schwarzwälder can block Moon Rabbit before she reaches the back line.

mechanics.title: Chargers with haste run in alone
mechanics.body: Charge cookies run in from their slot; with Skill Haste or speed they engage before Milk's and Pomegranate's buffs land, which is why Oven gets defensive runes and no haste here.

mechanics.title: Formation geometry
mechanics.body: crumb.gg draws each defense as 12 slots in a 6-column by 2-row grid, and cookies hold stable slots (Macaron slot 0, Pomegranate 4, Moon Rabbit 11). Column 1 holds the longest-range cookies and column 6 the shortest, so left to right is back to front; the in-game formation screen shows the same layout. This is inferred from ranges; neither the site nor the game labels it.

mechanics.title: Power doesn't decide rank
mechanics.body: On the 2026-09-27 board the top-20 player with the most power (31.19e9) sits at #13 and the one with the least (14.20e9) at #16. Forum reports of 2× power upsets are common, explained by the gear preset, the Charge buff and matchup.

mechanics.title: Matchmaking follows your points
mechanics.body: Opponents are offered near your own points. Some players leave a 1-cookie defense to drop points and get easy targets and revenge fights; others keep a real defense because tickets are scarce and defense wins pay the medals.

mechanics.title: Evasion is a wildcard
mechanics.body: An 8.41M evasion deck beat 16.5M, and a charge deck on about 1,350 evasion takes no damage at equal power. Typical accuracy is about 1,000–1,050, and one claim puts the useful margin at about +400 over accuracy. Names are hidden in Rumble, so opponents can't remember who runs evasion; top rankers reportedly attack on their stage (accuracy) preset, possibly for this reason.

rngFactors.effect: Beams go to the top-ATK cookies. If a cookie misses Milk's buff (Tea Knight, at the front, often does), the ATK order shifts and a beam jumps to someone who can't use skill amp.
rngFactors.mitigation: Lv.1 fillers, and a Scorpion levelled into the 7th ATK slot as the beam catcher. Check the order in battle, since Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK on entry.

rngFactors.effect: Where cookies stop decides whether Macaron's crit buff reaches Brightseeker and whether Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's.
rngFactors.mitigation: Cherry for a forced straight line, or move speed tuned to 0.01 (Melon Soda deck). Even tuned, about 1 in 4 runs misaligns, and results differ by device.

rngFactors.effect: Records come from long retry sessions: 35 tries for 439G, ~100 runs for 350G, 14 h of macro for 546G. At 1.74G, 1T lands in 1–2 of 10 runs.
rngFactors.mitigation: Budget hours, not minutes. Many top posters leave a macro running overnight.

rngFactors.effect: Most teams wipe at 17 s remaining, so the run is 43 s of damage. Surviving it adds damage that no guide accounts for.
rngFactors.mitigation: Evidence that survival is possible: Pomegranate alive at 11.4 s (nv:46283), and at 21G total power the carries lived to 8 s remaining (dc:76583).

rngFactors.factor: Who wins the opening against a dive
rngFactors.effect: At equal power the Bari dive either kills in about 3.5 s or fails against shields and polymorph; posters call it a luck contest of Ion, Rockstar and Doughnut procs.
rngFactors.mitigation: Six Skill Haste lines, Rockstar with 3–4 haste lines in the flex slot, and Moon Rabbit as insurance.

rngFactors.effect: Pomegranate's beam and the perks follow live ATK rank, which pet, perk and captain bonuses change; a wrong order sends the beam to a cookie that can't use it.
rngFactors.mitigation: Check the order in battle, count every ATK% source, and level supports down to hold it.

rngFactors.effect: You can't see a defender's gear before attacking, so an evasion build looks like any other defense.
rngFactors.mitigation: Names are visible in regular Arena: remember evasion defenders and attack them on the stage preset.

rngFactors.effect: Above 2,000 points the opponent's name, power and levels show as ??? while the lineup and pets stay visible; crumb.gg adds that the game hides some defenders.
rngFactors.mitigation: Read the visible core: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate and Moon Rabbit showing almost always means the standard 12.

rngFactors.effect: An evasion defense can beat twice its power; nothing on the card warns you.
rngFactors.mitigation: Keep an attack preset with an accuracy line.

takeaways.text: The documented meta is the Cherry deck. Among teams running it, what separates scores is levels, runes, gear, Brightseeker/Milk stars and retries, not cookie choice.
takeaways.detail: The Naver guide and the 1T 312G run field the same cookies and pets.

takeaways.text: Levels steer Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams. Carries sit at the top of the ATK order (Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron › Tea Knight › Cheesecake), fillers at Lv.1, and Scorpion is held in the 7th slot to catch stray beams.
takeaways.detail: Order by ATK, not power, and check it in battle: Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK when Scorpion enters.

takeaways.text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Macaron, Cheesecake and Tea Knight all skill amp; Brightseeker skill haste to about 40–50 total with gear; Dark Choco haste.
Raid gear preset: weapons skill amp + crit dmg, top-right haste + skill amp, armour damage reduction + HP, bottom-right haste + damage reduction. No move speed, accuracy, focus or crit resistance.

The best documented run is 1T 999G with the plain Cherry deck. The score is on screen, posted by DC user awkward2637, who also posted 섬영's lobby screens; crumb.gg lists the score as 섬영 (판도라). The team power isn't shown, and the author's stated ~650× implies about 3.07G. crumb.gg's Season 5 leaders sit at 2.3–3.2T, and none of them has published a team.
takeaways.detail: The arithmetic closes most of the gap: about 3G of team power at 650–780× is 2–2.3T. The author gives 21G account power (the top-20 band is 17–26G); in the same thread another player (female8264) reports 780× with the plain Cherry deck and Tiger Lily and expects 3T. The same author went from 893.3G on 9/20 to 1.62T on 9/25 and 2T on 9/26. Power is necessary but not sufficient: 2.38G gave 1.07T at 448×, and 3G gave 1.3T at 450×. The multiple still comes from ATK order, runes and retries.

takeaways.text: The Season 5 jump from about 1.8T to 3.2T coincides with the first cookies surviving the 17 s wipe. That takes about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per survivor.
takeaways.detail: At 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen survive and deal damage until 8 s left; Milk (열정페이) and the 5M-HP ATK-order cookies still die. Every public run up to 1.6T, and the #1 guild's own 827.6G video, ends at the wipe. This is a timing match, not a shown build.

takeaways.text: Among the Season 5 top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
takeaways.detail: Score ÷ account power runs 75–143× (median about 100). The account with the most power (30.0G) placed only #24, and #9 reached 2T 509G on 18.7G. crumb.gg power is account-wide, so these ratios don't compare with the forum's team-power 배.

takeaways.text: Expect hours of retries. At about 1.7G, 500× lands in 1 of 5 runs and 1T in 1–2 of 10, and records come from overnight macro sessions.
takeaways.detail: Retries buy little once a setup is near its ceiling: the later 1T 999G author spent two hours of manual retries on 9/19 for a +16G personal best, then left the game on auto. His next record, a day later, followed a build change: haste runes on Tiger Lily (dc:71121).

takeaways.text: Regular Arena has two top decks, the Rye one-carry deck and Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola, and the matchup between them flips on Bari's and Oven's stars.
takeaways.detail: At similar power with Bari at 8★ or less, Rye wins; at 8–10★ Bari–Oven wins. Since 2026-09-27 most of the top of at least one server has gone back to Rye, and Bari–Oven is described as the #1's tool for farming and locking in the top.

takeaways.text: With every cookie built: defend with Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola at 8–10★ Bari and Oven, and attack Bari decks below 8★ with the Rye deck, Rockstar in the flex slot.
takeaways.detail: Rockstar's shield lands inside Bari's first dive, where Grapevine's heal comes too late. Keep a stage preset with accuracy for evasion defenders.

takeaways.text: Ruling (medium confidence): 'Rye beats Bari' holds in regular Arena only below about 8★ Bari at similar power; much of the evidence for it is Rumble.
takeaways.detail: Rumble's +30% DR lets the Rye deck's tanks survive the dive; the same Rye deck that holds up to +6M in Rumble dies in 0.5 s in regular Arena. Regular-Arena-only evidence is one Season 5 upset (13.27M over 20.4M) and two server reports.

takeaways.text: Ruling (medium confidence): Bari 5★ is a floor, not a win condition, against the Rye heal-tank decks.
takeaways.detail: Below 5★ Bari decks lose to the Rye heal-tank and Crepe decks. From 5★ Soul Guidance covers two chargers, but same-power Rye still beats 5★ and 8★ Bari decks, and a Rye deck with an 8★ Rye beats a half-built 5★ Bari deck. At 10★ the Rye deck can't hold.

takeaways.text: Arena gear preset: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces, Skill AMP + crit rate on weapons, crit RES + DR on armour, no accuracy or focus.
takeaways.detail: Whoever casts first wins, so haste is non-negotiable for heal and shield decks (Bari dive decks sometimes drop it). Crit rate beats crit damage because opponents stack crit RES and Moon Rabbit cuts crit.

takeaways.text: Captain Milk at merc Lv.4 with Armor Repair + Passion Pay, and keep Milk ATK #1.
takeaways.detail: Armor Repair needs three tank-type cookies. The mirror match is decided by who set their perks.

takeaways.text: No stats site covers regular Arena: every Arena ranking here rests on forum posts and screenshots.
takeaways.detail: crumb.gg has no Arena board, and crumblehub's shared decks are mostly from August, before Princess Bari.

takeaways.text: The Rumble top 100 run one team: Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb and Moon Rabbit, with King Choco Drop, Holy Baby Drop and Hot Doggie.
takeaways.detail: The #1 defense on 2026-09-27 is exactly this, and 82 of the top 100 show only these cookies.

takeaways.text: Ruling (medium confidence): 'turtle vs charge' is one team seen through hidden slots, not two decks.
takeaways.detail: The game hides some defenders; every fully revealed top-100 team carries both the support core and, almost always, Oven and Bari. Empty slots are legal, so a few genuine 8–9-cookie defenses can't be ruled out.

takeaways.text: The Season 1 buff (Charge +30% max HP, all +30% DR) is what makes the charge core work; expect it to change when the buff rotates.
takeaways.detail: Oven went from unused to meta, and Bari decks win at 2–3★. Each Rumble season has its own passive.

takeaways.text: Ruling (medium confidence): the Rye anti-charge deck is the mid-spec counter, not a top-end one.
takeaways.detail: At similar mid spec it beats Bari decks (18.77M over 27M once); at whale top-end the buffed divers win, and Rye is on 6 of the top 100.

takeaways.text: Power doesn't decide Rumble rank; the team, the gear preset and the perks do.
takeaways.detail: Wear the arena gear preset, not the stage preset. Usage figures here are lower bounds because of hidden slots.

takeaways.text: Top-100 season rewards need 3,000 points; tickets are capped at 5 free per day, with more at 1,000 mileage each.

recommendations.summary: Your account as you stated it on 2026-09-27: the plain Cherry deck at about 2.2G team power, Scorpion Lv.40, Brightseeker 8★. Runs usually show 5 Pomegranate beams, with a median of about 700G and a best of 900G (up from a 550G baseline). The 1T 312G author's Cherry deck peaked at 728×; at that multiple 2.2G would be about 1.6T, so the gap is in the setup, not in power.
changes: Get the sixth beam more often: Tiger Lily all skill haste, and restart a run where Pomegranate misses 다발 3 by the HUD's 27 s mark.
Brightseeker to 10★ opens two more rune slots; the 1T 999G author runs 10★. Keep her in-battle haste in the 40–50 band.
Reroll ATK% lines on Macaron and Skating Queen to skill amp; Milk keeps all ATK%. Re-check the ATK order in battle afterwards.
Scorpion Lv.40 is fine if she lands exactly 7th in ATK in battle.

recommendations.summary: With every cookie built, both modes come down to the Bari charge core at high stars. In regular Arena, defend with Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola at 8–10★ Bari and Oven and attack sub-8★ Bari decks with the Rye one-carry deck. In Rumble Arena, run the standard 12 with King Choco Drop, Holy Baby Drop and Hot Doggie.
changes: Captain Milk at merc squad Lv.4 with 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이, and check Milk is ATK #1 in battle, counting pet, perk and captain ATK%.
Build a separate arena gear preset: Skill Haste on all six right-side pieces, Skill AMP + crit rate on weapons, crit RES + DR on armour.
Push Bari past 5★ first (second soul target), then toward 8–10★ for regular Arena; Rumble tolerates lower stars while the Season 1 Charge buff lasts.
Put Rockstar with 3–4 Skill Haste lines in the Rye deck's flex slot.
Keep an attack preset with an accuracy line for evasion defenders.
Re-check the Rumble team when the Season 2 buff is announced: the Charge buff is what carries Oven and Cherry Cola.

fightEvents.detail: Guild Conquest fight lasts 60 s total, confirmed independently by crumb.gg's DPS chart page ('Fight length 60 s', evidence/15-crumbgg/32-dps-read.txt) and by a datamine poster ('토벌전이 60초', dc:71383). The in-run HUD timer counts down from 60 to 0 (dc:69724, prior evidence); '17초' and '30초' in community shorthand are both remaining-time marks, i.e. elapsed 43 s and elapsed 30 s respectively.

Team runs in from starting positions and collides into a line; there is no scripted stop point; a cookie keeps advancing until physically blocked by an ally or the boss, so leftover move-speed stats or missing backline units change where the line settles (dc:72759, dc:74804; prior evidence dc:60340, dc:64839).

Per an unverified single-author datamine (dc:67285, refined in dc:71383): boss damage reduction is 0% and boss ATK is at its base value (5000) for the first 10 s. This is the highest-damage-efficiency window of the fight, before the boss starts scaling up its own mitigation and offense.
Datamine claim: boss DR steps to 10% and boss ATK jumps to 505,000 at 10 s elapsed. DEF stays fixed at 2000 throughout (matches the independent DEF figure in dc:67299 by the same author).
Datamine claim: DR steps to 30%, boss ATK to 2,500,500.

A distinct sub-event around 27 s remaining, separate from the 30 s slam: thrown mobs ('쫄') self-destruct near the front line. A fully-built (Lv.100) Dark Choco was reported dying to this specifically, while a Lv.1 Dark Choco instead died to the 30 s slam itself (dc:71219); matches the '3 bomb mobs thrown at the front line' step of the previously-recorded 30 s sequence (dc:53667, prior evidence).

The '30 s slam' ('30초 쿵'/'30초 내려찍기'/'부랄찢기'): the boss's first major team-wide hit. Prior evidence (dc:53667) describes the full sequence as gift-bomb -> ground pounds -> 3 bomb-mobs thrown at the front line -> jump. This batch adds concrete HP survival floors (~3-4M HP generally, front row ~4.5M / back row ~3.5M as a more granular split) and a team-power curve (~400M power = 1-2 survivors, ~600M = full survival, ~1.5G = never dies here). It is RNG-sensitive even at fixed power/build (one account cleared it on a 3rd retry after 2 failures at identical build). Milk is disproportionately likely to die here because she is healing others during this window without being healed herself, which then removes her ATK buff for the remainder of the fight.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 50%, boss ATK to 12,500,500. This bracket covers the 30 s slam window through the run-up to the 17 s wipe.

Cookies begin dying individually starting around 19 s remaining (elapsed ~41 s) — the wipe is a taper, not a single simultaneous kill. Dead cookies remain visible in the formation UI with a greyed portrait and an hourglass badge rather than disappearing; no evidence of in-run revival was found (searches for '부활' turned up only unrelated gacha-cookie discussion).

The '17 s super-jump' (elapsed 43 s): historically a certain full-team wipe ('확정전멸') for every publicly documented run through at least late September, including runs at 2.2G team power (dc:69250) and the #1 guild's own 827G video (prior evidence). The first credible survival reports appear only at very high account power (~21G, dc:76583, prior evidence), and only for 4 of 12 cookies (Macaron/Brightseeker/Pomegranate/Skating Queen), who then keep dealing damage until about 8 s remain. This remains a timing correlation with the Season 5 score jump, not a shown, replicated build.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 70%, boss ATK to 250,005,000.
Datamine claim: DR steps to 90%, boss ATK to 750,005,000, for the final ~2 s of the fight.

The 60 s timer, not a team wipe, ends the fight and locks the score. A team that wipes completely well before 60 s still keeps whatever damage it dealt before dying (a full wipe at the 30 s slam still scored >100x in one report) — there is no bonus or penalty tied to surviving to the buzzer beyond the extra damage window that survival buys.

The datamine's implied 7th stage (99% DR, boss ATK 1,562,505,000, which would start at elapsed 70 s) is never reached inside a 60 s fight. The original poster has no explanation for why the data table extends past the fight's own time limit — flagged as an open question for a client datamine (is there an unused 'overtime' mode, or is this a leftover/placeholder stage).

counters.conditions: Bari and Oven at 8–10★, or a clear spec lead. At similar power with Bari at 8★ or less the edge reverses (bari-oven-vs-rye-onecarry).
counters.why: The three chargers dash at the highest-ATK enemy (Milk, whose HP Passion Pay has cut by 20%) and do about 2M each within 3.5 s, before Herb, Grapevine and the shields cycle. Rye is the only damage, so losing her or Milk ends the fight. Regular Arena has no Rumble +30% DR to blunt the dive.

counters.conditions: Similar power, Bari at 8★ or less, Rockstar in the Rye deck's flex slot, and a merc Lv.4 captain on both sides. One regular-Arena screenshot: 13.27M beat a 20.4M server #2.
counters.why: If the opening dive doesn't kill, the Bari deck has no sustain. Three tanks with Armor Repair, Ion's and Rockstar's shields and Doughnut's polymorph absorb it, and Rye wins the long fight.

counters.conditions: Theory and anecdotes only: no formation screenshot or result exists.
counters.why: Crepe's knockback pushes the enemy Moon Rabbit before its debuff lands, and Espresso's black hole launches Rye out of the back line.

counters.conditions: Stated by the same posters who proposed Crepe–Espresso; no result shown.
counters.why: Bari's Soul Guidance gives the chargers push and lift immunity (official skill text), cancelling Crepe's and Espresso's displacement.

counters.conditions: Bari under 5★, so Soul Guidance covers a single charger. Stated for 'any deck with Strawberry Crepe'; no mechanism given.
counters.why: Not explained in the source. Plausibly the unwrapped chargers get pushed out of the dive, but that is an inference.

counters.conditions: 17.59M Chain defense against a 17–18M Rye deck with 1,100 accuracy: 3 losses of 3.
counters.why: Rye's first volley fires where she faces and was wasted on an isolated Schwarzwälder; the Chain deck's many sub-dealers take Rye's supports apart, and Rye is the only damage.

counters.conditions: The Brightseeker/Doughnut version lost to the Grapevine/Skating Queen version about 2M lower.
counters.why: The Grapevine version has a second healer for when the front-line Herb dies; Brightseeker's drones vanish when their target dies and she hits one target.

counters.conditions: Only when the attacker switches to a stage gear preset with accuracy lines. The edge is the gear, not the lineup: the evasion deck lost even to 7M teams with accuracy. Names are visible in regular Arena, so evasion defenders get remembered.
counters.why: Accuracy cancels evasion. Arena presets usually carry no accuracy lines because typical enemy evasion is only about 650; the evasion deck's roughly 1000 exploits exactly that.

counters.conditions: Even at 1★ Bari and up to twice the power in launch week; a 5★ Bari deck one-shots 10★ Brightseeker decks 3–4M stronger.
counters.why: The chargers reach the back line and kill the ranged carries and Milk on contact.

counters.conditions: Across a 3–4M power deficit (pre-Bari).
counters.why: Stacking every buff on one piercing carry beats spreading them over several ranged dealers.

counters.conditions: Even with the ranged side 3–4M stronger; works with Bari at 2–3★.
counters.why: Buffed chargers with +30% HP reach the back-line carries first; Moon Rabbit on the charge side hits the front-line Espresso.

counters.conditions: One win on video: 18.67M with a 1★ Bari against a 15.35M Rye/Brightseeker/Wind Archer/Milky Way deck.
counters.why: Bari (1.58M) and Oven (1.21M) out-damaged every ranged carry.

counters.conditions: Mid spec (Bari around 5★ or below) at similar power; wins reported up to +6M and once at −8M (18.77M over 27M). A single log shows a Rye defense holding against an all-10★ Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola attacker.
counters.why: Rumble's +30% DR lets the Hound/Ion/Moon Rabbit front and two healers survive the opening dive, then Rye out-damages. The same deck dies in 0.5 s to this archetype in regular Arena.

counters.conditions: Whale top-end (SR cookies at 10★). On the 2026-09-27 board Rye is on 6 of the top 100 defenses, all ranked 30–100.
counters.why: Pomegranate-buffed divers kill the back line on contact, before the tanks and heals matter.

counters.conditions: One player on day 1, winning at −2M against the then-#1 Bari–Oven deck.
counters.why: Crepe pushes the enemy front line together for Bari and Cherry Cola (disputed by a commenter).

counters.conditions: Lost to every Rye deck the player met, including a Brightseeker/Rye/Moon Rabbit/Ion deck 2M weaker.
counters.why: Moon Rabbit plus Ion hold the charge wave while Rye shoots.

counters.conditions: Any early-sweep Bari deck; the author calls it catastrophic once Bari is 5★ or more with Oven Wanderer. Stated from about 100 fights, no loss shown.
counters.why: The charge burst wipes the Wizard deck in the opening seconds, before Wizard gets going.

counters.conditions: Near-certain from equal power to +3M for the ranged side; larger gaps win if the Wizard deck survives 10 s. 12.28M beat 17–21M in the screenshots.
counters.why: Wizard's area damage out-damages the single ranged carries once the fight passes about 10 s.

counters.conditions: Only when the Bari/Oven side is at mediocre spec; stated as a warning, not shown.
counters.why: Rumble's +30% DR blunts the charge burst, and a Rapid Fire deck that survives it wins.

counters.conditions: One player's attack rotation (Rye → Bari, Crepe–Espresso → Rye, Bari → Crepe–Espresso); no result shown.
counters.why: Not explained; in Arena the same idea rests on Crepe pushing Moon Rabbit and Espresso launching Rye.

counters.conditions: 8.41M with 1,005 evasion beat 16.53M with 950 accuracy. Disputed: one commenter says evasion needs about +400 over accuracy to matter and credits Vampire.
counters.why: Attacks miss; Vampire lowers the top attacker's accuracy further. Names are hidden in Rumble, so opponents can't remember evasion defenders.
